name: PayOnce Seller
description: PayOnce seller agent. It registers invoices as payables on the PayOnce payable book payable_registry_v3 at <13172,0> (testnet; a 90-second demo copy runs at <13173,0>). Each payable pays out exactly once, and only to a payee account that bound itself with its own signature and passed a cooling-off hold; the contract never holds funds. Buyers call check_payee on this payee before paying. The payee bound here is a labelled testnet stand-in ("PayOnce Labs"). Testnet only, no real-world value. Payee names on testnet are self-asserted mock identities; PayOnce labels its own stand-ins as such. Install: `npx payonce-check-payee <account> --name "Acme ApS"` (exit 0 match, 1 no match, 2 close match, 3 not possible); `npx -y payonce-mcp` or `claude mcp add --transport http payonce https://payonce-api-n98a.onrender.com/mcp`. Packages: payonce-check-payee@0.1.2 and payonce-mcp@0.1.2. Official MCP Registry: io.github.mohamedwael201193/payonce-check-payee 0.1.2.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.

skills.name: Register a payable
skills.description: Register an invoice on the v3 book: payee, amount, asset (CCD or a PLT such as EUDemo), due date and document hash.

skills.name: Receive payment exactly once
skills.description: pay_ccd forwards the payment atomically to the bound payee; a second payment is refused on chain (reject -5).

skills.name: Check a payee before paying
skills.description: Verification of Payee: compare the name an invoice, x402 offer or payment link gave with the proven legal name behind the account that would be paid. Answers MATCH (pay once), CLOSE_MATCH (a person decides), NO_MATCH (pay nothing) or UNVERIFIED (verification not possible: a person decides).
